correctness.rationale: All three bracket identities reduce exactly to D=δT(D). The explicitly enumerated invariant 1-, 2-, and 3-dimensional blocks exhaust the 3(m+1) variables. Their polynomial characteristic factors and boundary row-rank computations prove every eigenspace dimension for all p odd, including p=3. Direct independent linear-system elimination matches 1023 finite prime-field cases; no experiments are used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for all restricted simple highest weights of sl2 in odd characteristic. The Steinberg δ=2 eigenvalue collision and p−2 degeneration give structurally motivated new boundaries in a subject with established δ-first Whitehead work; the distinction between algebraic and geometric multiplicity is not a routine parameter substitution.
